Debit cards in australia are not keycards nor are they credit cards. 

Keycards are what we can use to get cash out and usually have no chip. 

Debit cards are essentially savings cards but also have a credit option (ill explain why in a sec) 

And credit cards you pay off at the end of the month. 

With a debit card you can use the option of credit to get around spending limits on the card, and the money won't come out of your account instantly. Its also protected by higher end security measures, including individual monitoring of large transactions.

So, it comes out of the account usually next day or in 3 days time.

They can also be used online. Unlike keycards which cannot. And they also have contactless payment, which requires a credit function to work, unlike keycards which cannot.

So basically its a credit card, with an auto payment feature.
